title: Ronnie Knows Critters
description: A one-minute pet mailbag where Ronnie answers heartfelt animal worries with total confidence and zero competence. Every problem has one fix: just give it a job. Barry reads the saddest letters and quietly panics.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Ronnie Knows Critters. Your pet problems, my solutions. Barry, first letter.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Denise writes, quote, my old beagle Pickles won't eat. He just stares at the back door. I think he's giving up.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's not grief, Denise, that's boredom. A dog at a door wants to be a security guard. Just give him a job.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, he's fourteen. He can barely stand.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Then he's a SEATED guard, Barry. <p:0.3> Management. Next one.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Little Olivia, age nine, writes, quote, my goldfish Sunny is floating sideways at the top and I don't know what's wrong.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Olivia, Sunny's not sick. Sunny's on break. Just give her a job. Run her for the homeowners association. <p:0.3> She floats above the politics, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Olivia, sweetheart, go get a grown-up.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And an update. Denise writes, quote, Pickles got the security job. He let three raccoons in.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He's not management, Ronnie. <p:0.3> He's a liability.
